title: Portuguese Tofu Stew
description: A salty, pillowy, and show-off Portuguese dish featuring boiling water and render-fat, made vegan-friendly with tofu.

ingredients.name: Extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into 1 inch cubes

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to brown.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the dried thyme, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the cubed tofu and cook until it is lightly browned on all sides.
Add the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the stew for 20 minutes.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
